sample_unit: psychiatrists interviewed (plus 4 mental health apps analyzed)
unlisted_practices: Standardized ethical evaluation framework for AI-supported mental health applications, grounded in psychiatric ethics norms and Beauchamp and Childress's four principles

screen.reason: The study conducts an ethical and clinical audit of four commercial mental health AI apps (Wysa, Youper, etc.) and interviews psychiatrists to evaluate safety, crisis detection, and ethical alignment.
